agreement: Unanimous for split_seam_can_witness_host (3/3 choices). Response 3 decisive (0.81, conf 0.72); responses 1-2 near-splits (split 0.51/0.53 vs full 0.48/0.46, conf 0.26/0.30). inert_facts_only rejected in all three (~0.01): the I02 card's catalogue+Can mandate rules out behavior-free shapes.
advice_status: Agreement is advice, not proof. The integrator's independent pre-consult analysis already leaned split on the witness-independence argument (a candidate-callable witness breaks the K05 minted-triple binding: the candidate could instrument a different artifact than the one under test and claim its credit, and owner-gating does not help because native Can tests themselves hold owners). The Jev round confirms that lean; the decision below follows the confirmed lean, not the votes alone.
decision: Split the I02 merge along the purity boundary. The pure K04 seam checker becomes candidate-visible c:: catalogue operations (check_module, parse_module over module source text) with inert facts records, implemented by merged c-ingress.ts in runtime/test-support/slices/i02/ holding no witness authority. The stateful K05 witness merges to slices/i02/ as host harness tooling with NO catalogue operations, driven only by the QN2 qualification harness, preserving the K05 independence property that only co-minted token/id/digest triples verify. The Can package ports K04 verdicts (text::regex_match.groups + recursion; no str split) with the 19 K04 checks as fixture rows, validates inert witness facts, and ships a seam-validation example. NT-I02 admits the pure ops; witness liveness is qualified under QN2; source stays provisional until P14.
near_split_investigation: Responses 1-2 split 0.51/0.53 vs 0.48/0.46 for full_n_service: genuine tension between precedent-consistency (I01/I11 exposed full N-service mirrors with owner-first ops, NT tags, adapters and Can wrappers) and independence-preservation (K05 exists to catch a lying adapter; candidate-reachable instrument/invoke/observe lets the candidate mint credit for artifacts it chose). The full option's prose was not undersold (it carried the complete precedent list and QN2 qualification); Jev still preferred split in all three wordings, and decisively in the third. Mitigation for the precedent loss: implement the split but keep every precedent-consistent element that does not cost independence (owner-first op order for the pure ops, NT-I02 tag + scope elision, shared-owner adapter, emitter fixture chain through the real checker, pure-Can validators + example). The only deliberate departure from I01/I11 is witness authority placement, which is exactly what the K05 independence property requires.
